$Comment: The centred panel: a short stack in the middle of the screen for a value that moved while a
player had a page open (a shop, a board, the book, a conversation), where the game draws no HUD.
As shipped, a reputation change made in a page lands here, and one made out in the world stays
on the World bars. A row adds every further change to the same thing to the one number it shows
(+N, or -N for a net loss) and goes away a few seconds after it can be seen. Which panel a row
lands on is decided by the mod reporting it.
HoldWhilePageOpen is what makes it work: a row moved while a page is open waits, and shows for
its whole time once the player has no page open. A row already up when a page opens waits too
and shows again after.
MaxVisible is both how many rows show at once and the most that wait while a page stays open;
past it the oldest goes first. Set HoldWhilePageOpen to false to let rows run out under a page.
No spot is measured for this panel, so it names no Placement and states its own Position: a
corner preset plus pixel offsets. TopCenter hangs it from the top edge on the screen's centre
line, and OffsetY is how far down, clear of the boss bar and the zone banner the game draws
near the top; a nonzero OffsetX nudges it off centre. Columns 1 with RowsPerColumn 4 keeps it
one short column. Players may show or hide it on their Settings tab; with no spot offered, they
cannot move it. LabelKey names it there, and Order is where it is listed: lower numbers first,
so it comes after the World bars (10) and the Activity ledger (20).
To change a leaf without copying this file, add an entry keyed 'Center_Bars' to
mods/ziggfreedcommon/hud-panels.json with only the leaves you want different, or use the
server HUD layout page. Set Enabled to false to switch the whole panel off for everyone.
